Change only USB compatibility to 2.0; do not alter Hyper-V, VBS, quirks, drivers, firmware, or other VM hardware.
Start Ubuntu and connect candleLight USB-CAN to this VM. Tell the agent when completed; do not launch the robot one-key script.

Record a bounded 60-second pure-receive timeline and fresh passive SDK joint/enable feedback, without robot TX or motion.
Record the result and commit. Passive stability is not active-transmission or motion validation; arrange only the existing, explicitly scoped control-chain validation after successful checks.
If the new path still stalls, stop that branch rather than repeat motion; arrange rollback to the exact original USB compatibility and a distinct diagnostic.
